findings.title: LiteLLM recovery logic bloats main.py
findings.problem: LITELLM_MODELS_* constants, _reload_litellm_models, _initialize_litellm_models status handling and _schedule_litellm_models_recovery (about 100 new lines with their own constants, pure logic and tests) were appended to main.py (~1478 lines, app wiring). code-quality.md Module Cohesion lists appending a new concern to a 500+ line module as an avoided pattern.
findings.impact: Blocks the workflow per the documented code-quality standard; makes main.py harder to maintain and test.
findings.recommendation: Extract the constants, reload function and recovery loop into a new module (e.g. a rest_api litellm_models_recovery module or next to the enterprise litellm code) and import it from main.py.
